Synthetic backend: client sends HTTPS requests to an API.
The API writes jobs and an outbox row in one database transaction.
An outbox dispatcher publishes events to a queue, then marks rows as delivered.
Workers consume events and call an external provider.
Events may be redelivered; workers keep durable idempotency records.
